companyFieldUpdates.description: ValorC3 Data Centers is the operating name of Tonaquint Data Centers, LLC, a regional U.S. data-center platform providing colocation, private cloud, connectivity, disaster recovery, backup and build-to-suit capacity. The platform serves enterprise, channel and hyperscale customers from St. George, Utah, Boise, Idaho and Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. CVC DIF acquired a majority interest through DIF CIF III in December 2022; management retained a minority interest, while exact percentages and the legal closing day were not publicly disclosed. Tonaquint acquired EdgeX in November 2023 and began operating as ValorC3 on January 20, 2025 without creating a new company. Current materials report 19 MW of operating capacity plus a 10 MW Boise facility under development and a second 10 MW facility planned. A 2026 company financing announcement still identified CVC DIF as sponsor, and no later sale, transfer or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.
